summary: Shows klist output with both the TGT and an http service ticket cached, and that kdestroy clears the ticket cache.
questions: How do I see which Kerberos tickets I have cached?
How do I clear my Kerberos ticket cache?

answer_card.title: Viewing and clearing Kerberos tickets
answer_card.answer_md: `klist` lists cached tickets, e.g. the TGT under `krbtgt/MY.DOMAIN.COM@MY.DOMAIN.COM` and a service ticket under `http/server.my.domain.com@MY.DOMAIN.COM`. Use `kdestroy` to clear the cache.
